C0674.title: South Korea 'Telegram' Deepfake Sexual Crime Chatroom Incident
C0674.summary: In August 2024, numerous Telegram chatrooms using deepfake technology to create synthetic pornography were exposed on South Korean social media. Users could upload a facial photo, and a bot would generate a nude image within five seconds for a fee of approximately 650 won.
